_readme: One entry per client trial. The 'status' field is the only field the app reads: trial = normal countdown, active = fully unlocked (use after payment), revoked = locks the client's install immediately, any time. 'client' and 'created' are just notes for you — edit this file directly on GitHub, commit, and changes take effect for the client within about 6 hours (or immediately the next time they restart the app).
